facts.fact: Hadiah 站在她肘边劝阻：杀掉被囚的王子只会让他们成为殉道者，变成反对她统治的旗帜
Elise 对兄弟被关押一事只字不提，也没开口要什么，Tilde 知道她在等时机
facts.anchor: She had mentioned nothing of the prison I had put her brothers in

facts.fact: Tilde 已有身孕（乳房胀痛、恶心渐重），一手按腹，一手按在阳台绿叶上感应 kithwood 的脉动
facts.anchor: I put one hand to my belly.

facts.fact: 她想到把四位王子变成天鹅：没有尸体、没有死亡，连 Synod 也只能读作神罚
facts.anchor: They could be changed into something holy, something untouchable.

facts.fact: kithwood 拒绝讨价还价，自称没有忠诚、没有怜悯，是「古老的荒野」
facts.anchor: We are no servant who would kneel for you

facts.fact: Marolyn 自陈不适合宫廷，只求战士之死，请求 Tilde 把她献给 kithwood
facts.anchor: I am not built for this life, these games and politics.

facts.fact: Marolyn 被藤蔓贯穿而死，绿力经她的死涌入 Tilde，四名王子当场化为野天鹅破窗飞出
facts.anchor: The green came into me, with Marolyn’s life as the passageway.

facts.fact: 楼上阳台的 Elise 目睹全程，满脸恐惧与被背叛
facts.anchor: Her mouth was open, but no scream had come from it.
